articles.summary: Vancouver, British Columbia-(Newsfile Corp. - October 8, 2026) - Galiano Gold Inc. (TSX: GAU) (NYSE American: GAU) ("Galiano" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that it has secured the extension of the Abirem and Miradani Mining Leases at the Asanko Gold Mine ("AGM") in Ghana. The Abirem Mining Lease has been extended for 15 years through 2041, while the Miradani Mining Lease has been extended for 17 years through 2043. The Abirem and Miradani Mining Leases host the Nkran, Adubiaso and Miradani North deposits, including the AGM's 5.8 million tonnes per annum processing facility, associated infrastructure and Nkran Cut 3, a key component of the AGM's long-term mine plan. "We are very pleased with these extensions, which support the execution of our current life-of-mine plan and provide a strong foundation for Mineral Reserve growth and future mine life extension," said Matt Badylak, President and Chief Executive Officer. articles.title: Galiano Gold Secures Long-Term Extension of Key Mining Leases at the Asanko Gold Mine
